rca of the issue: Critical build-blocking SyntaxError in /app/frontend/src/member/workspace/Module1Profile.jsx: after the correct component export (ending line 185 with '};'), orphan lines 186-192 contained partial JSX ('refresh}', 'beforeGenerate={saveAndConfirm}', '/>', '', '', ');', '};') left over from a previous edit. Babel parser failed at line 186 col 7 ('Unexpected token'). Effect: CRA compiler failed => the ENTIRE app served the red 'Compiled with problems:' overlay for every route, blocking any UI use. Fix (applied): remove the 7 orphan lines. Verified compile + Module 1 + Module 2 UI render correctly. Reproduction: any GET on / , /login, /app/recruitment/self-guided/module/1 rendered the error overlay before fix.
